operations.summary: 固化为我的规则: becomes a user WAF/CC rule and leaves automatic management
operations.description: Writes the signature as the tenant's user-layer rule pack user/<tenant>/autodefense-<id> (one rule: waf block or cc JS challenge), enables it on the site and publishes the site's rule pack mounts with the three-layer conflict check. 409 autodefense_rule_conflict: the pack conflicts with the site's other enabled packs (nothing is written); 422 autodefense_not_compilable: a condition a user rule cannot match (ua, header order, behaviour buckets; cc has no JA4 / IP library match). The automatic signature is then withdrawn from every node.
